name: Shoujo Mahou Gaku: Little Witch Romanesque
original_name: 少女魔法学 リトルウィッチロマネスク
source:
Four moons illuminate the sky in an alternate world governed by swords, magic, and monsters. This realm, known as Stellamund, transitioned from the tumultuous "Age of Tower" to the flourishing "Age of Crown." During the bygone era, wizards who ignited a catastrophic war have since lost their influence and now quietly delve into arcane studies at the Grimoire Academy.

This narrative unfolds over three years, centering on an exceptionally gifted wizard born in this era, his female protégés, a relic from ancient times called the "Black Tower," where they reside, and the individuals drawn to them.

The protagonist, Domino, earned the distinction of becoming the ninth preeminent wizard at Grimoire Academy. His rapid ascent in the wizarding world was unprecedented for one so young, yet he soon grew disillusioned with the academy. The other eminent wizards viewed magic merely as a ladder to personal gain, neglecting its research for power struggles.

Seeking solitude, Domino relocated to the remote Black Tower, once inhabited by a legendary wizard from the Age of Tower. However, his peers disapproved and imposed a challenge upon him.

This challenge was to mentor a fully competent wizard within three years—a feat typically spanning decades. Adding to the difficulty, his two wards, Aria Vancliff and Kaya Xavier, were among the academy's most challenging students. Will Domino be able to complete this difficult task...?

[Edited from [url=http://www.akiba-ch.com/?p=528]Akihabara Channel[/url]]
translation:
在另一个由刀剑、魔法与怪物支配的世界，四轮明月照亮夜空。这片名为斯特拉蒙德的土地，已经从动荡的‘高塔时代’步入繁荣的‘王冠时代’。过去曾引发灾难性战争的魔法师如今失去影响力，只能在格里莫瓦学院静静钻研奥秘。

故事跨越三年，围绕这个时代诞生的一名天才魔法师、他的两名女弟子、他们居住的古代遗迹‘黑塔’，以及被他们吸引而来的人们展开。

主人公多米诺获选为格里莫瓦学院第九位大魔法师。他年纪轻轻便以前所未有的速度登上魔法界顶峰，却很快对学院心灰意冷。其他大魔法师只将魔法视为谋取私利的阶梯，忙于争权夺利，荒废了魔法研究。

为寻求清静，多米诺搬到偏远的黑塔居住，那里曾属于高塔时代的一名传奇魔法师。然而，同僚们不认可他的决定，并向他提出一项挑战。

这项挑战要求他在三年内培养出一名完全合格的魔法师，而此事通常需要数十年。更棘手的是，他的两名学生阿丽雅·凡克里夫与卡雅·泽维尔恰好是学院里最难教导的学生。多米诺能够完成这项艰巨的任务吗……？
